title: Model directory: sunset overlay & pricing contrast readiness pack
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a focused set of onboarding and release-note visuals for the model directory that clearly communicates: 1) new model launch states, 2) deprecation/sunset overlays and migration hints, and 3) compact pricing deltas for quick scanning. Deliver Figma files, PNG/JPEG exports at required sizes, alt-text copy, and localization notes for 6 languages.
acceptance_criteria: Figma master component for model card with 4 interactive states: default, selected, new-badge, sunset-overlay
High-fidelity screenshots exported at 1400x800 (hero), 800x450 (inline docs), and 360x640 (mobile) for each state
Pricing delta microcopy included in assets and supplied as separate CSV for translations
Contrast ratios for sunset overlay and pricing chips meet WCAG AA (>=4.5:1) and documented in accessibility notes
PM sign-off and engineering confirmation that assets align with current product styles and available CSS classes
screenshot_variants: hero-1400x800: full directory view with mixed new+sunset badges
inline-800x450: single model detail expanded with pricing delta tooltip
mobile-360x640: compact card stacks showing deprecation banners
component-sheet: isolated model card with layer toggles for designers and devs
dark-mode-variants: all above exported for dark theme
export_specs: File types: PNG (lossless) and JPG (for docs, quality 80)
Include 2x (retina) exports for mobile and inline sizes
accessibility_notes: Sunset overlay must use 0.72 alpha black with white text to reach 4.7:1 contrast on sample backgrounds
New model badge should be semantic (aria-label='New model') and not rely on color alone
Pricing delta chip text must be at least 14px medium weight or 12px bold to meet legibility
Alt-text templates provided for all screenshots (see attachments)
implementation_guidance: Use existing catalog grid CSS variables: --card-radius, --card-elevation, --text-primary
Sunset overlay CTA links should point to migration doc slug /docs/migrations/<model>-sunset
Provide both overlay and inline banner variants so docs can choose based on space
Include CSS class names in Figma notes for front-end engineers to copy

designer_notes: Primary goal is scan-first clarity in release notes: readers should instantly see which models are new, which are deprecated, and the net pricing change. Avoid heavy illustration to keep focus on metadata. Provide a minimal 'migration hint' row that can be toggled on/off in docs. Keep visual language consistent with console cards but reduce density for release-note context.
